text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (The air is fresh and the stars are out. It should be a nice run this evening.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Hm? Someone else is running at this hour?)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Just a little more…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I was hoping I'd be able to train alone…)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Oh well. There's no point worrying about it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (It's not a partner run. We just happen to be running individually, side by side…)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (We're physically close to each other, but in a way, we're incredibly far apart.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Yeah… This isn't bad. I feel like I could keep on running, no matter how long.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Phew…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (She's so dazzling… all alone. No matter how much I try to keep up, I can't close the distance at all.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Her footwork is just like…)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah… No, it's nothing. Are you going to keep running?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, just for a bit. Um, is it okay if I go?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: All right, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …I'm going to do a little more too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Almost as if engaged in a long and silent discussion, the two continue to run through the evening.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the encounter, Admire Vega becomes an even more formidable runner.
